title: The First Airplane Flight Covered Less Than Half a Football Field

scenes.text: The first airplane flight was shorter than half a football field.
scenes.keywords: wright flyer first flight kitty hawk

scenes.text: December 17th, 1903, Kitty Hawk. Orville Wright flew for twelve seconds.
They flew three more times that day. Wilbur's last flight went 852 feet in 59 seconds. Nearly seven times farther.
From twelve seconds in the air to the Moon in 66 years. Now watch the first flight again.

description:
The Wright brothers' first powered flight on 17 December 1903 lasted about 12 seconds and covered 120 feet.
That is less than half the length of a football field. Wilbur's fourth flight that day covered 852 feet in 59 seconds.
Did you know it started this small? Comment below.
first_comment: From a 12 second hop to the Moon in 66 years. What's the next leap?
